name: Internet exchange
simple: A meeting place where lots of networks swap parcels for free.
technical: An internet exchange is a big shared Ethernet fabric; networks peer over BGP, often via route servers.

1995.simple: DIX, where the Danish networks meet and swap parcels for free, so a Danish page never needs to cross the sea. A page from America doesn’t come this way.
1995.technical: DIX, the Danish Internet Exchange, started in 1994 by UNI•C at DTU in Lyngby: a shared Ethernet where Danish ISPs peer, reached here on its own E1. Only Danish routes are learned there.
